subject: Nanotechnology
title: Design Software for DNA Nanotech
description: A quick, practical guide to Design Software for DNA Nanotech.

hook.text: You do not design DNA origami by hand — software like caDNAno lets you draw shapes and outputs staple sequences.

buildup.text: caDNAno represents the scaffold as a grid of helices — you route staples across helices to create crossovers.

discovery.text: DAEDALUS automates wireframe design — input any polyhedral mesh and it outputs all DNA sequences needed to build it.

twist.text: Software predicts the ideal structure — but thermal fluctuations, salt, and sequence effects can surprise you in practice.

climax.text: Machine learning now optimizes staple sequences for folding yield — AI-assisted DNA nanotech is emerging fast.

punchline.text: Design on screen, fold in a tube — software makes DNA a programmable material.

quiz.question: What does the software caDNAno do for DNA nanotechnology?
options: It synthesizes DNA strands in an automated chemistry machine
It lets users design DNA origami structures and generates the required staple strand sequences
It analyzes the genetic code of organisms for medical purposes
